review_method: Direct visual inspection of each full-resolution still before rendering; not an automated guarantee of perfect anatomy.

rejected_assets.reason: Ambiguous duplicated sleeve/arm junction in phone-check pose; do not reuse.

A01_NOX_host.png.observations: Two front paws visible on desk; no extra visible paw. Stylized cat anatomy intentionally differs from human.

A02_key13_insert.png.observations: Key/tag ring attachments and physical numeral 13 reviewed; no human limb in frame.

A03_Maysa_arrival.png.observations: Two separate shoulder-arm chains: one lowered phone hand and one bag-strap hand; no duplicated arm visible.

A04_Maysa_phone_v03.png.observations: Replacement frontal pose: one continuous arm from each shoulder. Right elbow bent holding phone; left arm relaxed beside thigh. No overlapping duplicate sleeve. Face, hair and pre-uniform blouse checked against sheet.

A05_phone_map.png.observations: Visible grip reviewed: thumb and four fingertips wrap one phone; wrist continues into one sleeve. No detached extra hand.

A06_Maysa_hope.png.observations: Face/neck/visible shoulder silhouette reviewed. Hands and most arms are outside crop; no claim about hidden anatomy.

A07_Maysa_steps.png.observations: Rear full-body pose: two legs with distinct stair contacts, two arm chains; phone hand and bag strap separated.

A08_lobby_entry.png.observations: Rear Maysa silhouette and two manager arms reviewed at original resolution. No obvious duplicated limb found in this view.

A09_manager_waiting.png.observations: Two forearms, one watch hand, one ledger hand. Visible fingers reviewed; obscured fingers not inferred.

L02_landing_master.png.observations: Environment-only; rail, door and exterior bolt reviewed. No person present.

L03_exterior_master.png.observations: Environment-only; hotel entrance and two lamps reviewed. No person present.
